description:
Kiwi is a free and open source project that brings the macOS desktop to GNOME.

*Note. This extension is tested with the vanilla GNOME Adwaita theme. Other extensions may cause compatibility issues.

Features:
- macOS menu bar with the logo menu, app menus and Help search
- Kiwi's own Dock with Genie minimize, magnification and Stacks
- Window tiling, the green-button menu, Split View and Hide
- Stage Manager
- Mission Control, App Exposé and Launchpad
- App switcher, gestures and hot corners
- Spotlight search on a tap of Super
- Control Center, Notification Center and Focus
- Notification notch with live activities and a file shelf
- Desktop widgets
- Screenshots toolbar, emoji picker, colour filters
- Liquid Glass translucency
- Clipboard history and Quick Paste
- Multilingual support and more...

Every feature can be turned off in the preferences.

Clipboard history: Kiwi reads the clipboard to keep a local history (saved in ~/.local/share/kiwi/clipboard, never sent anywhere; password-manager copies are skipped).

Disclaimer: This extension is unofficial and not affiliated with Apple in any way.
name: Kiwi (is not Apple)
